news.headline:
Nomura says RIL shares corrected sharply ahead of Jio's listing, factoring in lower valuation and holding company discount.

Nomura finds Bharti Airtel's valuation discount to Jio unjustified, expecting the gap to narrow once Jio goes public.

Source: Business Today

Saurashtra Cement appointed Anurag Tiwari as Managing Director - Designate and Senior Management Personnel, effective October 16, 2026.

Anurag Tiwari brings 29 years of industry experience across companies like UltraTech Cement, Vedanta, Siemens, and L&T.
